container: ephemeral; --network none; root filesystem read-only; private tmpfs /tmp; source checkout read-only; evidence packet writable
xvfb: private display :88; --screen 0 1024x768x24 -ac; host PID exported as AGENT_INTERFACE_XVFB_PID per current CI workflow
decision_rule: The test process result and application task oracle are separate. Report PASS only if unittest passes, Xvfb provenance is present, source task effect multiplicity matches expectation, independent release and finite horizon readback are neutral, and the independent fresh-session task oracle passes. Preserve any extra effects as a task failure even when cleanup succeeds.
limits: Single synthetic Xvfb task pair; no MAP01, live provider, matched efficiency, reliability rate, or research-preview acceptance.
